IBM.rationale: IBM presents a quality franchise in active transition with solid YoY growth (+9.5% revenue, +14.3% EPS), exceptional cash conversion (OCF/NI 4.2x, $5.17B in Q1), and meaningful profitability improvement (ROE 20.3%→32.5%, net margin 8.7%→15.6%). The software mix shift is producing visible margin expansion (+140 bps operating margins), and the Z mainframe moat plus Red Hat hybrid cloud provide defensible recurring revenue. However, the stock has already rallied +22% from April lows, the P/E at 26.1x—while compressed from ~50x—yields only 3.8% versus a 4.54% risk-free rate (negative 74bp spread), and the balance sheet carries elevated leverage (total liabilities/equity 3.73x). Consulting grew only 1% in Q1, the z17 cycle introduces a known future headwind, and AI bookings ($12.5B cumulative) require proof of conversion pace. The upcoming Q2 2026 earnings is a credible near-term catalyst—if it confirms strong seasonal earnings, trailing P/E could compress toward 20x. On balance, fundamentals are improving but much is priced in; the score reflects mild attractiveness with the Q2 report as a modest positive modifier.
